content: कालिङ्ग {%a.%} (-ङ्गी|{%f.%}) [कलिङ्ग-अण्] Produced in, or belonging to, the Kaliṅga country. .{@-ङ्गः@} .²1 A king of that country; प्रतिजग्राह कालिङ्गस्तमस्त्रैर्गजसाधनः <ls>R. 4. 40</ls>. .²2 A snake of that country. .²3 An elephant. .²4 A species of cucumber. .²5 A poisonous plant. .²6 A sort of iron. .{@-ङ्गाः@} (<ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a country; see कलिङ्ग. .{@-ङ्गम्@} A water-melon.
